schemaVersion.description: Generator schema version, always the component id.

title.description: Short title for students in plain text.

figureId.description: Id of the library figure this lesson labels.

id.description: Lowercase kebab part id, 40 characters or fewer.

name.description: Part name with the words the page uses, 1 to 40 characters. It occurs in the quote.

sourceId.description: Id of the source the quote was copied from.

quote.description: Exact characters copied from the source, no ellipsis, 150 characters or fewer.

x.description: Horizontal point on the part itself, never on its printed label, normalised 0 to 1000.

y.description: Vertical point on the part itself, never on its printed label, normalised 0 to 1000.

labelX1.description: Left edge of the box around the printed part label, normalised 0 to 1000; all four label edges are 0 when there is no printed label.

labelY1.description: Top edge of the box around the printed part label, normalised 0 to 1000; all four label edges are 0 when there is no printed label.

labelX2.description: Right edge of the box around the printed part label, normalised 0 to 1000; all four label edges are 0 when there is no printed label.

labelY2.description: Bottom edge of the box around the printed part label, normalised 0 to 1000; all four label edges are 0 when there is no printed label.

areaX1.description: Left edge of a box around ALL drawn pieces of this part (every arrow, the whole cloud), never its printed label, normalised 0 to 1000; the point lies inside it.

areaY1.description: Top edge of a box around ALL drawn pieces of this part (every arrow, the whole cloud), never its printed label, normalised 0 to 1000; the point lies inside it.

areaX2.description: Right edge of a box around ALL drawn pieces of this part (every arrow, the whole cloud), never its printed label, normalised 0 to 1000; the point lies inside it.

areaY2.description: Bottom edge of a box around ALL drawn pieces of this part (every arrow, the whole cloud), never its printed label, normalised 0 to 1000; the point lies inside it.
